name: Normet Spraymec NorRunner 160 DVC
summary: Road-legal, truck-based wet-mix shotcrete sprayer for medium to large tunnel profiles, with a wireless-remote spray manipulator and a remote driving system for moving the truck. SmartSpray spraying automation and SmartScan thickness scanning are available.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by the Finnish maker Normet through its local offices. Normet's contact page lists European offices in Austria, Finland, France, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, but none in Germany. No German dealer, rental offer or price found.

sellers.name: Normet Group
sellers.note: Contact form and local office finder; nearest listed offices to Germany are Austria and Switzerland.

specs.quote: a maximum horizontal coverage of 23 meters and a vertical one of 16.5 meters

specs.label: Concrete pump output
specs.quote: Concrete pump output: Up to 30 m3/h

specs.label: Electro-hydraulic power pack
specs.conditions: for spray boom, concrete pump, S-tube and dosing
specs.quote: 75 kW electro-hydraulic power pack for the spray boom, concrete pump, S-tube and dosing system

specs.label: Spraying automation

notes: Road-legal truck carrier with one spray manipulator; outdoor true because the truck drives on public roads (maker: road-legal).
Can spray on diesel, on the electro-hydraulic power pack, or plugged into the mains without local emissions (maker).
SmartSpray automation levels: Lite keeps the nozzle aligned; Pro adds point-to-point moves; ProPlus sprays a defined area automatically (maker).
